versions.subject: feat: add new rule for "SmadHook.dll" potential sideloading (#4282)
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImageLoaded|endswith:
        - '\SmadHook32c.dll'
        - '\SmadHook64c.dll'
filter_main_legit_path:
    Image:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\SMADAV\SmadavProtect32.exe'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\SMADAV\SmadavProtect64.exe'
        - 'C:\Program Files\SMADAV\SmadavProtect32.exe'
        - 'C:\Program Files\SMADAV\SmadavProtect64.exe'
    ImageLoaded|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\SMADAV\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\SMADAV\'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_main_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded IN ("*\\SmadHook32c.dll", "*\\SmadHook64c.dll") NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\SMADAV\\SmadavProtect32.exe", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\SMADAV\\SmadavProtect64.exe", "C:\\Program Files\\SMADAV\\SmadavProtect32.exe", "C:\\Program Files\\SMADAV\\SmadavProtect64.exe") ImageLoaded IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\SMADAV\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\SMADAV\\*"))
